products.short_description: Define the C2M migration and code-promotion method — OUAF config migration, code/IWS promotion, environment comparison — so what you tested is what goes live, Dev→QA→Prod, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Promote C2M config and code cleanly across environments

C2M configuration and extensions have to move from Dev → QA → Prod without drift or manual mistakes. This solution defines the migration and code-promotion method: OUAF configuration migration (bundles / Configuration Migration Assistant), code and web-service promotion, and environment-comparison — so what you tested is exactly what goes live, pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the C2M promotion model: OUAF config migration (bundles/CMA), code/IWS promotion, and environment comparison.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (source+target environments, migration tooling, access, change control).
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to export/import OUAF config bundles, promote code and web services, compare environments, and validate parity, across Dev→QA→Prod with gates.
  • 5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (config migrated, parity confirmed, no drift) plus Best Practices for repeatable promotion.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

C2M configuration and code promoted cleanly from Dev to QA to Prod — parity confirmed, no drift — so what you tested is exactly what goes live.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • Automation Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OC2MMIG-Discovery.sh — read-only inventory of a C2M/OUAF environment for migration & code promotion
    • OC2MMIG-Remediation.sh — guided, DRY-RUN-by-default remediation of promotion parity gaps
    • OC2MMIG-Report.sql — read-only source-vs-target compare report for a promoted scope
    • OC2MMIG-ScopeHelper.sh — resolve and print a Migration Request's declared scope
    • OC2MMIG-Validation.py — read-only WLST parity validation of a promotion target

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
